nse_summary: Hindustan Unilever Limited has intimated that its management representatives will participate in the CITIC CLSA India Forum. The event is scheduled for 16th November 2026. The meeting will be conducted in physical mode. This communication is filed pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015. The company secretary Radhika Shah signed the notice on 9th November 2026.
